Coastal Hazard Message
National Weather Service Anchorage AK
328 PM AKDT Fri Oct 23 2026

AKZ755-240900-
/O.CON.PAFC.CF.Y.0003.000000T0000Z-261024T0900Z/
Kuskokwim Delta Coast and Nunivak Island-
328 PM AKDT Fri Oct 23 2026

...COASTAL FLOOD ADVISORY REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 1 AM AKDT
SATURDAY...

* WHAT...Coastal flooding, with water levels of 2.0 to 3.0 feet 
  above the normal highest tide line, and 35 to 50 mph winds 
  with gusts up to 75 mph. 

* WHERE...Kuskokwim Delta Coast, including Kipnuk, Kwigillingok 
  and Kongiganak. 

* WHEN...Now through 1 AM Saturday, particularly around high 
  tides near 10 PM tonight. 

* IMPACTS...Coastal flooding of low lying areas and erosion are 
  possible. 

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The most likely scenario is for water
  levels to be 2.0 to 3.0 ft above the normal high tide line.
  While very unlikely, the worst case scenario for Kipnuk is for 
  water levels to be 3.5 to 4.0 feet above the normal high tide 
  line, while the worst case for Kwigillingok is 4.0 to 5.0 feet 
  above the normal high tide line. The peak will be around 10 PM 
  tonight, coincided with high tide.
  

PRECAUTIONARY/PREPAREDNESS ACTIONS...

Precautions should be taken to protect property.

$$

AKZ764-240900-
/O.CON.PAFC.SU.Y.0008.000000T0000Z-261024T1500Z/
Northern Bristol Bay Coast-
328 PM AKDT Fri Oct 23 2026

...HIGH SURF ADVISORY REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 7 AM AKDT
SATURDAY...

* WHAT...Water levels most likely around 1.0 to 2.0 feet above 
  the normal highest tide line, with highest water levels 
  expected near Togiak. 

* WHERE...Northern Bristol Bay Coast.

* WHEN...Now through 7AM Saturday

* IMPACTS...Nuisance flooding of low lying areas. Coastal 
  erosion is possible. 

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...A Bering front brings a prolonged period of
  strong southerly winds towards the coast. These winds will
  result in elevated water levels and high surf. This period of
  winds will coincide with a high tidal cycle this evening and 
  push water levels 1.0 to 2.0 feet above the normal highest tide 
  line. Water levels are expected to quickly drop off Saturday 
  morning as winds decrease, alleviating coastal concerns. 

PRECAUTIONARY/PREPAREDNESS ACTIONS...

Precautions should be taken to protect property.

&&

JAR

$$
